site.title: Yggdrasil Graph
site.tagline: The end of the myth is already written in the family tree.
site.description: An interactive relationship graph of Norse mythology. Gods, giants, monsters, worlds and named things, with every relation traced to a primary source.

graph.regionDescription: An interactive graph of {count} figures and the {links} relations between them. Use the list view below for a linear equivalent.
graph.regionDescriptionSubset: An interactive graph showing {visible} of {total} figures and {links} relations. Search or show all to explore the full corpus; the table below is the linear equivalent.
graph.showAllHint: Expand the graph from its core argument to the full corpus.
graph.hintKeyboard: Tab into the graph, then move between figures with the arrow keys.
graph.motionReduced: Motion is reduced, so the graph is showing its settled layout.

view.label: View
view.listDescription: The same data as the graph, in a form you can read straight through, search with your browser, or hand to a screen reader.

panel.label: Details
panel.empty: Nothing selected. Choose a figure in the graph.

filters.label: Filters
filters.heading: Show
filters.disputedOnlyHint: Shows variant and disputed relations by themselves.
filters.ragnarokOverlayHint: Dims everything except the combatants at the end of the world and the bloodlines that produced them.
filters.disputedOnAnnounce: Only where the sources disagree. Showing {visible} of {total} figures and {links} relations.
filters.disputedOffAnnounce: Disputed-only filter cleared. Showing {visible} of {total} figures and {links} relations.
filters.ragnarokOnAnnounce: Only Ragnarök. Showing {visible} of {total} figures and {links} relations.
filters.ragnarokOffAnnounce: Ragnarök overlay off. Showing {visible} of {total} figures and {links} relations.
filters.bothOnAnnounce: Only where the sources disagree and only Ragnarök. Showing {visible} of {total} figures and {links} relations.

certainty.label: Certainty
certainty.impliedHint: The source entails this without saying it.
certainty.unverifiedHint: Believed true, but no locus has been confirmed. Deliberately uncited.

entity.noDescription: No account has been written for this figure yet. The relations below are the whole record.

sources.heading: Sources
sources.intro: Every relation in this graph points at a locus in one of these works. The editions cited are all in the public domain; their text is not reproduced here.
sources.uncited: No citation. Marked unverified on purpose.

footer.editionsNote: Citations follow Bellows (1923) for the Poetic Edda and Brodeur (1916) for the Prose Edda.

a11y.graphInstructions: Arrow keys move between connected figures. Enter opens details. Escape clears the selection.
a11y.selectionCleared: Selection cleared. Showing the whole graph.

error.notFoundBody: That path does not lead anywhere. The graph does.
error.graphFailed: The interactive graph could not start. Everything below still works.
